intended_object: The degree-one corestriction (transfer) map cor: H¹_cts(H, X) → H¹_cts(G, X) for an open subgroup H of finite index in a topological group G. On crossed homomorphisms it is given by the standard transversal formula. Inferred from the docstring, the name, and the companion definition `corestrictionOne`, which instantiates it at the default transversal.
